description: The Vienna Heating Plan 2040 is a two-page map with legend published by the City of Vienna's energy planning department (MA 20) as an orientation for a climate-neutral heat supply by 2040, with a status of September 2026 and underlying data from the city, Wien Energie and Wiener Netze. It divides the city into areas by recommended heat supply: district heating today (connected areas), district heating future (planned expansion where dense development, high heat demand and limited local renewables make it suitable), local collective heating in heating neighbourhoods, and local individual heating for less densely built areas, marking city and district boundaries. News coverage says the plan targets renewable heating and hot water by 2040 with district heating covering 56 percent of demand, but that figure was not confirmed on the map. Access: free PDF download with a web page at the city's heating plan address; no licence is stated. Coverage is the city of Vienna. Caveats: a summary map, not a downloadable geodata layer; only the PDF text was read. It suits capacity planning studies of district heating expansion, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
